profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Siemens EDA
profile.summary:
Graphical User Interfaces are often lacking in many areas. My aim is to produce the best Computer Aided Design tools that are user-friendly, intuitive, easy to use, automated, and visually brilliant to help further science and technology and add to the progression of a physics- and environment-aware society.

Specialties: Electrical Engineering, Electromagnetics, Automation, Interfaces, Scripting.
Computer Programming: C++, Python, Qt, SWIG, HTML, Java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Designer of Scripting (Automation), Controller, Integration, Graphical User Interface (Visualization and Advanced User Interaction) for several enterprise-level software projects.
Application Engineering and Customer support.

positions.title: Senior R&D Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Designer of console mode operation, Graphical User Interface, Visualization, and Advanced User Interaction for several enterprise software projects.
Application Engineering and Customer support.
Create and maintain help manuals and documents.

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description: Lead Designer of Graphical User Interface, Visualization, and Advanced User Interaction.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Designed a new type of user interface to connect user input to an Electromagnetic Solver.
Taught students over three semesters in a lab environment; graded reports and homework.

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description:
Designed a system to demonstrate location enablement of advanced weapons systems using GPS satellites.
Integrated a GPS receiver module, controller hardware, and supporting software into the system.
Developed a presentation on the ideas and motivation behind the project and gave the presentation.
Demonstrated the working project to upper management and fellow employees.
